description: This PHP source file defines the PackageManagerDisplay class, which provides static methods for building and rendering various user interface components related to package management in SuiteCRM, including package display, patch display, license display, and tree view construction.

classes.name: PackageManagerDisplay
classes.description: A class providing static methods for rendering package management UI components in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: buildPackageDisplay
methods.description: Builds the HTML for the package manager interface, including header, tree view, and installed packages grid.

methods.name: buildPatchDisplay
methods.description: Builds the HTML for patch management interface, including download options and login panel.

methods.name: buildInstalledGrid
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying installed modules or packages.

methods.name: buildLoginPanel
methods.description: Creates HTML for the login dialog panel.

methods.name: buildGridOutput
methods.description: Generates HTML for the category and package selection grid.

methods.name: buildTreeView
methods.description: Constructs a tree view object representing package categories.

methods.name: getLicenseDisplay
methods.description: Returns HTML form to display license agreement from a file.

methods.name: getDisplayScript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for package management page functionality.

methods.name: createJavascriptPackageArray
methods.description: Creates JavaScript array representation of package release data.

methods.name: createJavascriptModuleArray
methods.description: Creates JavaScript array of module data for UI display.

methods.name: buildLicenseOutput
methods.description: Builds HTML to display license contents inline.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves header information including login status and promotional message.

methods.name: buildInstallGrid
methods.description: Builds grid of installed upgrades/modules for display.
